summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Access Control Panel with role-based preview mode. Backend API tests: 8/8 PASSED. Frontend UI tests verified: role tabs, preview mode, toggle functionality, Show All/Hide All, module toggle, Exit Preview. Found 1 BUG: Preview mode doesn't change Dashboard layout based on preview role - only filters items.

ui_bugs.issue: Preview mode doesn't change Dashboard layout based on preview role. When previewing as Capex Head, the Dashboard still renders the admin layout (which shows only Cost Savings card after filtering) instead of the Capex Head layout (4 cards: Budget Utilized, Pending Approvals, Cost Savings, Completion Rate). The hasAccess filter works correctly, but the role-based conditional rendering (user?.role === 'capex_head') doesn't consider the preview role.

action_items: FIX: Dashboard.jsx should use previewRole from useAccessControl hook to determine which stat card layout to render. Currently it uses user?.role which doesn't change in preview mode. The fix should check: const effectiveRole = previewRole || user?.role; and use effectiveRole for conditional rendering.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 80: useAccessControl returns previewRole but it's not being used for layout decisions
Dashboard.jsx lines 137-139: isUserRole, isBuyer, isDeptHead should consider previewRole
Dashboard.jsx line 888: user?.role === 'capex_head' should be effectiveRole === 'capex_head'

success_rate.frontend: 95% (preview mode works but layout doesn't change)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Access Control Preview Mode testing completed.
